Meta and OpenAI introduced autonomous AI agents, Muse and ChatGPT Dots, designed to run independently after user sessions end.

Both systems utilize cloud computing environments to execute ongoing tasks, connect to external services, and handle workflows like shopping and research.

While Muse operates on dedicated virtual machines, OpenAI integrates its agents directly into ChatGPT.
